spec.situation_desc: needs a replacement for a lost card

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Good afternoon, Thistle Bank, Sam speaking. How can I help?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Hi, I’ve lost my bank card and need a replacement.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I’m sorry to hear that. I can help with that. Before we discuss your account, could you tell me your full name and date of birth, please?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Thank you. And the first line of your address?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Thanks, Ruairi. I’ve verified your details. When did you last have the card?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Yesterday evening, I think. I’ve looked around at home and in the car, but it’s not there.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: That’s frustrating. I’ll block the lost card so it can’t be used, then arrange for a replacement to be sent to your address on file.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: The replacement usually takes several working days to arrive. I’ll submit the request now, and your existing card will no longer work once it’s blocked.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I’ll just take a moment to process that for you.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: The lost card is blocked, and I’ve submitted the replacement request. You’ll receive it by post at the address we have on file. Is there anything else I can help with today?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: No, that’s everything. Thanks for your help.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: You’re very welcome, Ruairi. Thanks for calling Thistle Bank. Goodbye.
